message.text: I am searching the repository for all types declaring a method named RunOnce. I will identify every declarer and determine which production callers invoke each declaration.

Only two types declare RunOnce: s3presign and memopayload.

Verifying whether memopayload is invoked from production code. Reading both files and checking for additional RunOnce declarations on other receivers or interfaces.

Checking for additional RunOnce declarations in standalone functions or other languages.

Grep found two RunOnce declarations. Now checking test files for memopayload.RunOnce calls and verifying no oer RunOnce patterns exist.

Two RunOnce declarers were found.

`s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` is invoked from production code. `server/serpresignRunner.RunOnce` calls it during `startBackgroundRunners`. The runner also invokes it internally in its `Run` method, which is called from `server.go:169`.

`memopayload.Runner` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` is declared but never invoked from production code.

h08.
**s3presign.Runner** — **yes** — **`server/server.go`** (`startBackgroundRunners`, line 163: `s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)`); also **`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`** (`Run`, line 36: `r.RunOnce(ctx)`, started from `server/server.go` line 169)

**memopayload.Runner** — **no** — **(none)**

A repo-wide search for `func.*RunOnce` and `.RunOnce` in `*.go` found exactly two method declarations:

| Declarer | File | Production callers |
|---|---|---|
| `(r *Runner) RunOnce` in package `s3presign` | `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` | `server/server.go:163` (direct at startup); `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (every 12h via `Run`, started at `server/server.go:169`) |
| `(r *Runner) RunOnce` in package `memopayload` | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` | None |

`memopayload` is used in production, but only via **`RebuildMemoPayload`** in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — not via `RunOnce`. There are no production references to `memopayload.NewRunner` or `memopayload.RunOnce`, and no test references to either `RunOnce` method.
